title: AgriAdaptAI_FertilizerFeatureSchema
description: Validation schema for input features to the AgriAdapt AI fertilizer recommendation model.

crop.description: Target crop cultivated on the field.

state_name.description: Indian state or union territory where the field is located.

crop_season.description: Agricultural cropping season (optional, auto-derived from crop if omitted).

nitrogen__nutrient_index.description: Ramamoorthy & Bajaj Nutrient Index for Nitrogen (1.0=Low, 2.0=Medium, 3.0=High).

nitrogen__pct_low.description: Percentage of soil samples in the district testing low for nitrogen.

nitrogen__pct_medium.description: Percentage of soil samples in the district testing medium for nitrogen.

nitrogen__pct_high.description: Percentage of soil samples in the district testing high for nitrogen.

phosphorus__nutrient_index.description: Ramamoorthy & Bajaj Nutrient Index for Phosphorus.

phosphorus__pct_low.description: Percentage of soil samples testing low for phosphorus.

phosphorus__pct_medium.description: Percentage of soil samples testing medium for phosphorus.

phosphorus__pct_high.description: Percentage of soil samples testing high for phosphorus.

potassium__nutrient_index.description: Ramamoorthy & Bajaj Nutrient Index for Potassium.

potassium__pct_low.description: Percentage of soil samples testing low for potassium.

potassium__pct_medium.description: Percentage of soil samples testing medium for potassium.

potassium__pct_high.description: Percentage of soil samples testing high for potassium.

soil_ph__nutrient_index.description: Soil pH Index mapped to fertility scale (1=Acidic, 2=Neutral, 3=Alkaline).

soil_ph__pct_low.description: Percentage of soil samples with acidic pH.

soil_ph__pct_medium.description: Percentage of soil samples with neutral pH.

soil_ph__pct_high.description: Percentage of soil samples with alkaline pH.

nitrogen__total_samples.description: Total volume of soil samples analyzed in the region.

recommended_n_kg_ha.description: Recommended elemental Nitrogen application dose per hectare.

recommended_p2o5_kg_ha.description: Recommended available Phosphate application dose per hectare.

recommended_k2o_kg_ha.description: Recommended available Potash application dose per hectare.
